assistworld-assist-world:lever:2f8563bf-.description: We are looking for a highly proactive, organized Executive Assistant to support the Head of IT/Technical Support at a growing company. This is not a traditional administrative role. The successful candidate will take ownership of a busy workload, keep projects moving, stay ahead of deadlines, and ensure clients and internal teams receive timely communication. The Head of IT currently has a significant backlog of projects, tasks, and client issues. Your role will be to bring structure and accountability to that workload, allowing them to focus on higher-level technical work. If you need to be told what to do every step of the way, this role is not for you. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done, takes action, follows up, and keeps things moving without constant supervision. Key Responsibilities Executive & Calendar Management Manage and organize the Head of IT's calendar. Schedule meetings, appointments, and follow-ups. Protect time for high-priority technical work. Identify scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them. Ensure important meetings, deadlines, and commitments don't fall through the cracks. Project & Task Management Maintain visibility over the Head of IT's active workload and projects. Track outstanding tasks, deadlines, and deliverables. Follow up proactively on items that are overdue or stalled. Help prioritize competing demands and keep projects moving forward. Maintain organized task lists and project records. Identify bottlenecks before they become problems. Client Communication Communicate with clients via email regarding technical issues, updates, delays, and resolutions. Provide timely updates when problems arise. Follow up with clients to ensure issues are progressing. Escalate technical matters to the appropriate person when required. Maintain a professional, helpful, and reassuring tone in all communications. CRM & Administrative Support Update and maintain CRM records. Keep client information and activity accurately documented. Track open issues, communications, and follow-ups. Assist with organizing internal processes and documentation. Take ownership of recurring administrative tasks and improve processes where possible. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate is: Extremely proactive — you don't wait for instructions. Highly organized and naturally good at keeping track of multiple moving pieces. Comfortable managing a busy caseload and competing priorities. Confident communicating with clients professionally. Strong with follow-up and accountability. Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment. A problem solver who looks for solutions rather than simply identifying problems. Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new systems. Reliable and consistent with excellent attention to detail. A Key Requirement: Ownership We are looking for someone who will effectively take charge of the administrative workload . For example, if you notice that a client has been waiting three days for an update, you shouldn't wait for someone to tell you to follow up. You should recognize the issue, investigate what is needed, contact the relevant person, and make sure the client receives an update. Proactive thinking and initiative are essential to success in this role. Required Skills & Experience Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Project Coordinator, Operations Assistant, or similar role . Experience with calendar management . Experience using a CRM system . Strong written English and professional email communication. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision. Strong computer and technology skills. Preferred Spanish-speaking/bilingual candidates are preferred, but Spanish is not required. Experience supporting an IT, technical support, software, or technology t

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Tilde (FL110) Tilde Bio, Inc. (FL110) is building a next-generation biological sensing platform at the intersection of synthetic biology, protein engineering, nanopore biophysics, electrophysiology, signal processing, and machine learning. Our goal is to create programmable biological measurement systems capable of extracting rich molecular information from single-molecule interactions. We believe nanopores generate a high-dimensional measurement of molecular identity and behavior that remains largely untapped. Unlocking that information requires new computational approaches — ones that don't yet exist — built by people who are comfortable working at the edge of what's known. At Tilde, you will work alongside scientists and engineers from diverse disciplines to help define how a new generation of biological sensing systems extract meaning from the physical world. Tilde is backed by Flagship Pioneering, which brings the long-term vision and resources needed to build platforms that don't fit neatly into existing categories. Position Summary We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in printed circuit board (PCB) design and development to join our multidisciplinary engineering team. This individual will play a critical role in the design, layout, integration, and validation of complex PCBs that support our next-generation proteomics platform. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in mixed-signal and high-speed PCB design, signal integrity, power integrity, and system-level integration. This role requires close collaboration with firmware, mechanical, bioengineering, and systems teams to deliver robust, manufacturable, and high-performance hardware solutions from concept through production. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and development of complex, multilayer PCBs for advanced instrumentation systems. Architect mixed-signal, high-speed, and low-noise circuit designs including analog front ends, power management, data acquisition, and embedded processing systems. Collaborate with SW and HW engineers as well as external vendors to ensure seamless hardware–software integration and instrument development. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation including schematics, layout files, validation reports, and specifications. Drive design reviews, design for manufacturability (DFM), and design for testability (DFT) best practices. Contribute to intellectual property generation and technical strategy discussions. Basic Qualifications B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 7+ years of industry experience in PCB design and hardware development. Demonstrated expertise in multilayer PCB design for mixed-signal or high-speed systems. Experience with high-speed interfaces (e.g., USB, Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, SPI, I2C). Deep understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, grounding strategies, and EMI/EMC mitigation. Hands-on experience with board bring-up, debugging, and lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers). Experience taking products from prototype through manufacturing. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Nice-to-Haves Experience designing electronics for scientific instrumentation, medical devices, or life sciences platforms. Familiarity with FPGA-based systems and embedded processors. Experience with high-density interconnect (HDI) design and fine-pitch components. Knowledge of regulatory compliance standards (e.g., CE, FCC, IEC). Experience working in early-stage or startup environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6319d00d-f574-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This role offers the opportunity to lead Environmental, Health, and Safety initiatives across a dynamic and evolving operational segment. You will own the implementation and management of EHS programs while partnering closely with field and operational leadership. Strong knowledge and demonstrated expertise in EHS principles, compliance requirements, risk management, and workplace safety practices. You will assess pronunciation, pacing, tone, emotional expression, and regional characteristics to help improve Icelandic voice models. Evaluate AI-generated speech and voice outputs for linguistic accuracy, naturalness, clarity, and overall performance quality. Contribute to the creation and improvement of high-quality training data used to strengthen AI speech and voice models. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c1f8bb62-96c3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in United Kingdom. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c618dbee-35b3-.title: CRM & Communications Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c618dbee-35b3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CRM & Communications Coordinator based in Germany. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of CRM and high-volume communications across a growing multi-brand portfolio. You will ensure landlords and tenants receive the right information, through the right channel, at the right time. Working in a fast-paced, product-focused environment, you will manage email operations, audience segmentation and recurring communications at scale. You will help build repeatable systems that make it easy to integrate newly acquired brands into a consistent communications infrastructure. The role combines operational discipline, clear copywriting, data analysis and process improvement with hands-on CRM execution. You will use automation and AI tools to reduce repetitive work while continuously improving engagement, deliverability and communication quality. This is an ideal opportunity for an organised, self-directed CRM professional who enjoys creating structure and scalable processes in a high-growth environment. Own and manage the Mailchimp database across multiple brands, including contact imports, list hygiene, unsubscribes, bounces and data accuracy. Build and maintain detailed audience segments based on contact type, brand, geography and lifecycle stage to ensure communications reach the appropriate audiences. Plan, deploy, schedule and monitor high-volume email communications while maintaining strong deliverability and sender reputation. Manage the communications calendar, including monthly newsletters, regulatory updates, platform announcements and tenant-facing messages, adapting shared templates for individual brands. Monitor and report on key email performance indicators such as open rates, click-through rates and unsubscribes, using insights to improve segmentation, timing and messaging. Onboard newly acquired brands into the CRM infrastructure by importing and cleaning contact lists, establishing segments, creating templates and implementing recurring communication schedules. Develop and maintain a reusable library of email templates, copy blocks and brand assets to accelerate future brand onboarding and ensure consistency. Use Zapier and AI-powered tools to automate repetitive content-production activities and CRM workflows as the portfolio expands. Maintain clear documentation covering CRM processes, workflows and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability and effective knowledge transfer. Support the creation and adaptation of visual assets for email communications and templates using tools such as Canva and Figma. Manage Google Business Profile activities across the wider portfolio. Requirements Experience working within a mature CRM environment, ideally in technology, e-commerce, fintech or another fast-growth business where communications are managed at scale. Hands-on experience with CRM and email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo or similar systems, including audience management, campaign execution and automation. Practical understanding of email infrastructure and deliverability, including sender domains, authentication, list hygiene and sender reputation. Ability to work confidently with email templates and make basic HTML/CSS adjustments when required. Strong understanding of effective email copywriting, with the ability to review, refine and improve content produced by others. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence engaging with UK-based stakeholders. Highly organised and self-managing, with the ability to work effectively even when information or processes are incomplete. Strong process-oriented mindset, with the ability to standardise fragmented workflows, document processes and create repeatable systems. Comfortable taking a hands-on approach while continuously looking for ways to improve how work is performed. Proact

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:35294e8f-180f-4bb7.title: Personal Assistant - Platform
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:35294e8f-180f-4bb7.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. SKELAR Platform — операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Поки команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті, 15+ команд у складі Platform під ключ закривають Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Communications, IT та інші функції для всієї екосистеми. Зараз ми в пошуку Personal Assistant в SKELAR Platform. Ти станеш правою рукою CEO бізнесу — тим, хто тримає в фокусі десятки задач одночасно і дає СЕО простір думати про стратегію, а не про логістику. Які виклики тебе чекають: — Виконуватимеш та координуватимеш операційні, адміністративні й організаційні задачі CEO — від підбору подарунків для партнерів до супроводу комплексних проєктів; — Підтримуватимеш CEO в особистих запитах, що потребують оперативного рішення, пошуку інформації чи координації підрядників; — Організовуватимеш ділові та особисті поїздки під ключ: бронюватимеш авіаквитки, готелі й трансфери, готуватимеш маршрути, плануватимеш зустрічі та бізнес-заходи; — Проводитимеш ресерч і аналіз інформації за запитами CEO, готуватимеш порівняння, рекомендації та стислі висновки для прийняття рішень; — Підбиратимеш і координуватимеш подарунки для партнерів і колег — від генерації ідей до контролю закупівлі та доставки; — Шукатимеш рішення для нестандартних задач, взаємодіючи з внутрішніми командами, підрядниками та зовнішніми партнерами. Що для нас важливо: — Рівень польської — B2, англійської — від B1; — Проактивність: вмієш передбачати потреби CEO та знаходити можливості оптимізувати його час; — Прокачані організаційні та комунікаційні навички; — Гнучкість і ефективність у багатозадачності, вмієш швидко розставляти пріоритети та керувати часом; — Стресостійкість і готовність працювати з приватними задачами; — Відповідальність і ownership — доводиш задачі до результату, не втрачаючи їх на етапі виконання; — Вміння швидко знаходити інформацію, аналізувати дані та структурувати висновки й рекомендації. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:f19954.title: Engagement Manager, Mid-Market
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:f19954.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As an Engagement Manager, you'll be the driving force behind the AI search program for your customers, ensuring successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing engagement with the Profound platform. You'll work directly with customer stakeholders to provide strategic consultation, success planning, and targeted support to help them hit their AI search goals. Partnering closely with internal teams across Sales, Product, and Engineering, you'll address customer needs, deliver meaningful outcomes, and serve as a trusted expert guiding customers through the future of AI search with best practices and actionable tactics to enhance their AI visibility. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of 45 to 55 mid-market customers - Own the full customer journey from onboarding and implementation through driving measurable business outcomes with the Profound platform - Develop and execute a combination of white-glove initiatives and scaled strategies to ensure strong customer health and engagement - Become an expert in the AI search space and develop a strong understanding of how large language models work - Effectively multi-thread customer engagements to mitigate risk from stakeholder turnover - Partner closely with the Account Management team to ensure value delivery aligns with commercial goals - Collaborate internally with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to optimize implementation and resolve technical challenges WHO YOU ARE - 2 or more years of experience working with mid-market customers to drive strategic outcomes in a customer success, account management, or consulting capacity - Excellent communication skills with the ability to deliver presentations and demonstrations effectively - Self-motivated and driven, with a passion for building strong customer relationships - Comfortable diving into challenges and operating in ambiguous environments - Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with quantitative data - Ability to own processes end to end with strong critical thinking skills and project management skills - Comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously - Experience in the search or marketing industry LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF, or London office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $110,000 to $180,000 before variable compensation (NYC). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, variable compensation, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-PRO Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
